property.name: dgpId
property.label: Document Generation Process ID
property.description: The Id of the DocumentGenerationProcess record created earlier in the flow.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Title shown on the card. Defaults to 'Generated Document'.

property.name: contentDocumentId
property.label: PDF Content Document ID
property.description: ContentDocumentId (069) of the generated PDF. Bind this to the native File Preview component on the SAME screen for reactive inline preview.

property.name: contentVersionId
property.label: PDF Content Version ID
property.description: ContentVersionId (068) of the generated PDF. Useful for a Download action elsewhere in the flow.
